title: AI search visibility with Notra
description: Run AI visibility scans on ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini, and read mention rates, competitor share, content gaps, and agent readiness with Notra.

environment.name: NOTRA_API_KEY
environment.description: Notra API key (ntra_...) from the API Keys page at app.usenotra.com, with the read and write scopes of the routes you scaffold. Keep this server-side.

environment.name: NOTRA_FUNCTION_TOKEN
environment.description: Random token (at least 32 characters, for example from openssl rand -hex 32) callers send as Authorization: Bearer <token>; required because Neon Function URLs are public.

operations.title: List projects
operations.description: POST to list your Notra projects and their ids, which every other route takes.

operations.title: Start a visibility scan
operations.description: POST a projectId to ask ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and the other tracked engines every prompt of the project; returns a scanId.

operations.title: Check a scan
operations.description: POST a projectId and scanId to get the scan's status and mentions per engine.

operations.title: Read visibility per engine
operations.description: POST a projectId and optional days (1-365) to get mention rate, citations, and average position per AI engine.

operations.title: Read competitor share
operations.description: POST a projectId and optional days (1-365) to get how often each brand is mentioned in the answers.

operations.title: List content gaps
operations.description: POST a projectId to list prompts where competitors are mentioned and you are not, ranked by opportunity.

operations.title: Check agent readiness
operations.description: POST a projectId to get how well AI agents can read and use your site, or set rescan to start a new check.
